text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer connected sentences with transitions like \"In additon,\" \"Again,\" and \"For instance,\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay more clearly links ideas across paragraphs and moves through points with some organizational signaling."},{"evidence":"formal opening and closing to the principal","quality":"audience awareness","description":"It shows a more appropriate essay format and tone for a school-based persuasive letter."},{"evidence":"\"erasect some student's favorite cafeteria foods\" and \"keeping our school's lunch menu is a good idea\"","quality":"task control","description":"The essay stays more directly focused on a single argument and supports it with reasons tied to the prompt."},{"evidence":"\"actually healthy\" points with fruits, vegetables, green salad, protein, Vitamin D","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It gives more specific supporting details and examples to elaborate the main claim."},{"evidence":"\"definetely,\" \"In additon,\" \"focuse,\" \"respectively\"","quality":"conventional spelling","description":"Although imperfect, the writing shows somewhat stronger control of common word forms and conventions than the other essay."}]}
